semantic_findings: Deepfake, phishing and account takeover are presented as overlapping operational angles with novice definitions and a sourced LINE relationship chain.

Independent verification is worked through with a prior saved phone number, the specific invitation/request, the no-contact fallback and the LINE code non-disclosure boundary even when identity is confirmed.
Real Taiwan/Hong Kong cases preserve date, location, currency, number, medium and investigative qualification; the five practice cases and new worked examples are clearly teaching simulations.

All six answers use their actual retrieved sections; cards distinguish used claim_ids from broader retrieved_claim_ids. Current card query_sha256 values match the actual query bytes. These checks establish traceability, while semantic support was separately read.
TikTok labeling, Meta recovery and LINE advice retain their announcement scope; there are no universal detection, coverage, prevention, recovery or learning-effect guarantees.
The practice implementation uses authored feedback and in-page self-comparison, with no audio/media detection or AI grading. Reason text is not sent or persisted by the inspected practice script.

confirmation_sequence.assessment: The record confirms this revision only. Observed Git sequence is confirmation→Wiki refinement→teaching build; no retroactive approval of the initial version is claimed.

residual_minor_limitations: 這是對目前教材、證據與封存官方主張的獨立內容審查；不取代原案件鑑識，也不是2026年平台所有版本或帳號復原流程的實測。
五題均有理由輸入與自查判準，但沒有學習者前後測、延後測或真實受騙風險降低的證據；不能保證遷移效果。
部分錯誤選項仍會刻意暴露明顯風險，適合初學者；不足以證明面對複雜真實情境也能正確決策。
本審查核對已渲染HTML的教材文字；版面、鍵盤、手機、列印與公開發布狀態由另一輪實際瀏覽器驗收處理。
